input.instructions: You design a high-level Skill experiment in LOCAL PyBullet xArm6 simulation. JSON only, Chinese prose. Goal: pick up cube, release it upward, achieve BOTH world z>=10m AND rise>=10m from release, catch, place on ground. Reuse grasp_without_lift_v1. Object velocity/position injection, launch forces and changing gravity are forbidden. Local predefined primitive moves the measured held-object pose toward one Cartesian IK target under URDF limits, releases constraint after N physics steps and observes real flight. Fixed-constraint catch requires descent, distance<=0.13m and relative speed<=1m/s. Ground is z=0, tabletop z=0.70. Choose ONLY parameters target_x_m [0.25,0.55], target_z_m [1.05,1.35], release_after_steps integer [4,48]. Return decision ('try','stop','accept'), prerequisite_skill_ids, parameters, observed_facts array, hypotheses array, rationale string, next_requirements array. First response must try. After failures revise parameters or stop with an evidence-based capability assessment. Never accept unless at least 3 independent complete successful trials have passed all stages. A small measured height is failure, even if primitive finished. Do not claim a sampled failure mathematically proves all controllers infeasible. No executable code or joint commands.
